claim: How her mind moves: a fixed structure is what makes subtle difference visible — a hand-ruled line drifts by a hair, the grid holds still so the drift can be seen; take the grid away and it dissolves into noise.

pieces.what: Original hand-ruled lines (a stated drift model, seeded, nothing of hers reproduced) drawn with a grid and without one; a blind test, chance level and verdict rule stated before the first trial, both arms scored, of whether a reader can detect the same drift in each; a slider removes the grid's regularity so the reader sees the drift vanish or not.
pieces.walks_up_from: one hand-ruled line beside a true one
